title: Light Is Fast — Space Is Bigger
description:
Light travels fast enough to circle Earth about 7.5 times in one second. Yet sunlight still needs about 8 minutes 20 seconds to reach us, and even light takes about 4.25 years to reach Proxima Centauri.

Sources: NIST and NASA.
